name: North Gate Pass
summary: North Gate Pass carries travelers between Dun Morogh and Loch Modan through the Khaz Modan peaks. A fortified dwarven outpost watches this northern corridor, used by travelers bound for the Wetlands.

sections.title: Gateway Between the Peaks
sections.body: North Gate Pass cuts through Khaz Modan between Dun Morogh and Loch Modan. From the west, travelers emerge from steep mountain tunnels into the broad loch valley. Roads lead down toward the Wetlands, bringing dwarven messengers, merchants, and wandering adventurers through the pass. North Gate Outpost gives the route its strategic value, with mountaineers watching for troggs and mountain predators.

faq.q: Where does North Gate Pass lead?
aliases: where does north gate pass go
faq.answer: North Gate Pass connects eastern Dun Morogh to northwestern Loch Modan. The road continues north around the loch toward mountain tunnels that descend into the Wetlands, making the pass a critical junction for northern travelers.
Ironforge Mountaineers keep North Gate Outpost directly along the road. They monitor travelers and keep the mountain passage clear of prowling beasts and roaming troggs.

faq.q: How does this differ from South Gate Pass?
aliases: difference north and south gate pass
faq.answer: Both passes link Dun Morogh to Loch Modan through carved tunnels. North Gate Pass offers the most direct overland route for travelers heading toward the Wetlands and northern lands.

angles.text: For dwarves traveling between Ironforge and the frontier settlements around The Loch, North Gate Pass is a familiar, stone-hewn threshold guarded by fellow mountaineers.
For the Alliance, North Gate Pass is a vital military and supply corridor connecting the dwarven capital to northern expeditions bound for the Wetlands.
